Football.title: From turgid to thrusting - mixed start for new Scotland

articles.title: From turgid to thrusting - mixed start for new Scotland
articles.standfirst: BBC Sport Scotland's Tom English reviews a mixed start to life as Scotland head coach for Sebastien Pocognoli as his side open their Nations League campaign with a goalless draw in Slovenia.

gist: Scotland drew 0-0 with Slovenia in Sebastien Pocognoli's first match as head coach.
A poor first half was followed by a dominant, attacking second-half performance.
Scotland missed several clear chances but showed tactical promise under their new manager.

sections.heading: What happened
sections.text: Scotland drew 0-0 against Slovenia in manager Sebastien Pocognoli's first game. After a disjointed first half with no shots on target, a tactical shift at half-time sparked a dominant second-half performance. Scotland registered 17 shots, but Oli McBurnie, Robbie Ure, and Kieron Bowie all missed key chances to score.

sections.heading: Why it matters
sections.text: The result means Scotland have failed to score in three consecutive tournament matches for the first time in nearly 22 years. However, Pocognoli's tactical adjustments showed promise, and all ten starting outfield players registered a shot on goal for the first time since June 2022.

sections.heading: What happens next
sections.text: Scotland will face Switzerland, who are ranked 14th in the world, on Tuesday night at Hampden.

gist: Carlos Alcaraz saved match points to defeat Taylor Fritz at the Laver Cup.

sections.heading: What happened
sections.text: Carlos Alcaraz defeated Taylor Fritz in a deciding tie-break after saving two match points. Earlier, Alex de Minaur beat Alexander Zverev and Learner Tien defeated Flavio Cobolli. sections.heading: Why it matters
sections.text: The victory prevented back-to-back singles defeats for Alcaraz and kept Team Europe ahead going into the final day as they chase their sixth title.

sections.heading: What happens next
sections.text: The tournament concludes on the final day, where match wins are worth three points. The first team to reach 13 points will lift the trophy.

articles.standfirst: There is fresh uncertainty around the proposed Tyson Fury v Anthony Joshua fight - after Dana White said he did not know whether it would happen.

gist: Dana White cast doubt on whether Tyson Fury and Anthony Joshua will fight.
A promotional dispute emerged over Dana White's involvement and contractual restrictions.
Netflix and Turki Alalshikh announced the bout for 11 December in Cardiff.

sections.heading: What happened
sections.text: Tyson Fury and Anthony Joshua were announced to fight on 11 December in Cardiff, live on Netflix. Within 24 hours, uncertainty arose due to a dispute over promotional rights and contract provisions involving Dana White, Eddie Hearn, and Frank Warren.

sections.heading: Why it matters
sections.text: Eddie Hearn claimed Joshua's contract prevents White from having a promotional role, leading to talk of possible contractual breaches and replacement fights. Meanwhile, White criticised Hearn, and key figures exchanged cryptic social-media posts.

sections.heading: What happens next
sections.text: A news conference is scheduled in London, though uncertainty remains over whether it will take place. Officially, Netflix continues to list the fight, but the contractual disagreement must be resolved.

gist: Demi Vollering won the women's road race world title in Montreal.
Kasia Niewiadoma-Phinney finished second after challenging in the closing stages.
Elisa Longo Borghini took the bronze medal.

sections.heading: What happened
sections.text: Demi Vollering won the women's road race world title in Montreal after a thrilling victory. She held off a late challenge from Kasia Niewiadoma-Phinney to claim victory. Elisa Longo Borghini took bronze after edging out Marlen Reusser, while an early downhill crash involved multiple riders.

sections.heading: Why it matters
sections.text: The victory adds another major title to Demi Vollering's remarkable season, following her successes at the Tour de France Femmes, Giro d'Italia Women and spring classics.
